title: World English Bible Classic
description: The World English Bible is a Public Domain translation of the Holy Bible into modern English. Includes Apocrypha/Deuterocanon. The Classic edition is in American English. It uses "Yahweh" for God's proper name in the Old Testament.

title: World English Bible
description: The World English Bible is a Public Domain translation of the Holy Bible into modern English. This edition omits the Deuterocanon/Apocrypha, but is otherwise identical to the World English Bible Updated.
